Metadata.description: Install reusable agent skills, manage them with sb-kit, or scaffold a Next.js and Hono project.

Hero.eyebrow: The CLI for coding agent skills
Hero.title: Give your agents a workflow.
Hero.description: Install skills for planning, debugging, review, and documentation. Pick the workflows your project needs, or start a new app with Next.js and Hono.
Hero.dockInstruction: Select a module to explore its workflow.
Hero.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy automatically. Select the command to copy it.

Features.title: Skills and scaffolding for your projects.
Features.description: Choose the skills your project needs, inspect what’s installed, and start a new app when you need one.

clarity.title: Install selected skills
clarity.description: Pick the skills you want from a single checklist. sb-kit installs them in .agents/skills and can also install them for Claude Code in .claude/skills.

context.title: Inspect and update
context.description: Use doctor to inspect your local setup without network access. Use update to refresh managed skills and review the changes before applying them.

action.title: Scaffold a full-stack app
action.description: Create a project with a Next.js client and Hono API using the next-hono template.

Approach.title: Start from your terminal.

focus.label: Install
focus.title: npx sb-kit install
focus.description: Select one or more skills from the checklist. The default Install missing only mode keeps existing skills in place.

explain.label: Inspect
explain.title: npx sb-kit doctor
explain.description: Check which skills are present in the current project.

invite.label: Create
invite.title: npx sb-kit create next-hono my-app
invite.description: Scaffold a new Next.js and Hono project in the my-app directory.

update.label: Update
update.title: npx sb-kit update
update.description: Preview updates to managed skills. Existing content is backed up before an approved update is applied.

Approach.requirements: You’ll need Node.js 20.12 or newer and npm. Run the install command inside the project where you want to use the skills.

SkillExamples.title: See the skills in action
SkillExamples.description: See what happens after you give your agent a feature request or a project idea.

execute.title: From request to implementation
execute.description: Use this workflow when you want to change an existing project. You approve both what will change and how the agent plans to change it.

investigate.title: Read the existing code
investigate.description: Trace the affected code and gather evidence.

spec.title: Write the spec
spec.description: Describe what should change and define the acceptance criteria.

approveSpec.title: You approve the spec
approveSpec.description: Confirm the behavior and scope before planning.

plan.title: Draft the plan and checklist
plan.description: Identify the files to change and review the order of work.

approvePlan.title: You approve the plan
approvePlan.description: Review the proposed changes before implementation starts.

deliver.title: Implement, review, and hand off
deliver.description: Make the approved changes, review the diff, and report the result.

nextHono.title: Set up your Next.js and Hono workspace
nextHono.description: Run this skill after scaffolding the pnpm workspace to configure the Hono runtime, data layer, and frontend-to-API setup.
nextHono.client: App Router frontend. It stays on its existing runtime when you change the Hono runtime.

server.node: Runs the Hono API with the Node.js adapter. This is the default scaffold.
server.workers: Adapts the existing Hono API to Workers with Wrangler and typed bindings.

nextHono.data: The Hono server owns the database connection, Drizzle schema, and migrations.
nextHono.auth: When authentication is selected, Next.js proxies protected browser requests on the same origin and Hono enforces role boundaries.
nextHono.storage: Add object storage when your project needs it.

idea.title: From one idea to three project docs
idea.description: The agent clarifies one decision at a time, drafts an overview and spec for your feedback, then writes the implementation plan.
idea.hint: Click Idea to see the three files this skill prepares.
idea.complete: 3 documents ready. Click Idea to replay.

files.overview: Problem, target users, and project goals.
files.spec: Scope, user flows, and acceptance criteria.
files.plan: Implementation phases, dependencies, and completion criteria.

Contact.title: Questions or feedback?
Contact.description: Report a bug or suggest an improvement through GitHub Issues, or find the package on npm.
